colossians.1.p1.b1.text: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Timothy our brother,

colossians.1.p2.b1.text: To the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae:

colossians.1.p2.b2.text: … Grace and peace to you from God our Father.

colossians.1.p3.b1.text: We always thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, …

colossians.1.p3.b3.text: because we have heard about your faith in Christ Jesus and your love for all the saints—

colossians.1.p3.b4.text: … that has come to you. All over the world this gospel is bearing fruit and growing, …

colossians.1.p4.b1.text: You learned it from Epaphras, our beloved fellow servant, …

colossians.1.p4.b2.text: … who is a faithful minister of Christ on our behalf,

colossians.1.p4.b3.text: and who also informed us of your love in the Spirit.

colossians.1.p5.b1.text: For this reason, since the day we heard about you, we have not stopped praying for you …

colossians.1.p5.b2.text: so that you may walk in a manner worthy of the Lord and may please Him in every way: …

colossians.1.p5.b3.text: He has rescued us from the dominion of darkness and brought us into the kingdom of His beloved Son,

colossians.1.p5.b4.text: in whom we have redemption, the forgiveness of sins.

colossians.1.p6.b1.text: The Son is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn over all creation.

colossians.1.p6.b2.text: For in Him all things were created, … All things were created through Him and for Him.

colossians.1.p6.b3.text: He is before all things, and in Him all things hold together.
